title: The Mario family 马里奥一家人

script.textEN: The Marios live at 87 King Street.
script.textCN: 马里奥一家住在国王街87号。

script.textEN: Mr. Mario goes to work by car.
script.textCN: 马里奥先生开车去上班。

script.textEN: The children go to school by bus.
script.textCN: 孩子们乘公共汽车去上学。

script.textEN: Mrs. Mario stays at home. She drinks tea in the afternoon.
script.textCN: 马里奥夫人待在家里。她下午喝茶。
